invariant_bindings.invariant_text: Every data_class that stores PII, PHI, or PCI MUST have an EncryptionPolicy bound; writes without resolve() succeeding SHALL fail.
at_rest_cipher MUST be one of the approved set (AES-256-GCM, ChaCha20-Poly1305); unapproved ciphers SHALL raise on bind.
in_transit_min_tls MUST be TLS1.2 or higher; binding TLS1.0 or TLS1.1 is FORBIDDEN.
key_provider MUST reference an external KMS; raw key material in configuration files is NEVER permitted.
rotation MUST be <= 365 days for PCI data_classes; a longer cadence CANNOT be bound.
